sentences.en: I do not expect you to subscribe to my opinion.
sentences.zh: 我不指望你认同我的观点。

sentences.en: I got a premium for subscribing to the magazine.
sentences.zh: 订阅杂志后我得到了一份礼品。

sentences.en: Have you ever subscribed to any English language newspaper?
sentences.zh: 你有订阅过任何英文报纸吗？

senses.zh: 订购，预订 - 同意；赞同
